response: Yes, correlated results are possible from homebrew assays for BCRABL transcript detection by quantitative real-time PCR. According to studies, despite significant differences in methodologies, laboratories can obtain comparable results if they use the same positive control cell line and quality control gene. However, it is essential to adopt some level of assay standardization between laboratories to ensure accurate and reliable results, particularly for patients being monitored at different facilities and for larger investigative studies.
